# blog.allegro.tech

> > Allegro's engineering blog covering microservices architecture, JVM technologies (Java, Kotlin), mobile development (iOS, Android, Lynx), AI/ML applications, and large-scale platform engineering.

This is the technical blog of Allegro, one of Europe's largest e-commerce platforms. The blog documents their engineering journey, including their decade-long microservices transformation (Project Rubicon), platform optimization, and adoption of modern technologies across 2000+ services.

## Key Topics

- Microservices Architecture
- Java & Kotlin (JVM)
- Gradle & Dependency Management
- Mobile Development (iOS, Android, Lynx)
- Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
- Behavior-Driven Development (BDD)
- Code Migration & Automation
- Kubernetes & Platform Engineering
- AI/ML & LLM Applications
- Testing & Test Automation
- Spring Framework (WebFlux, Spring AI)
- MongoDB & Data Persistence
- OpenRewrite & Dependabot
- REST API Design
- Go & Garbage Collection

## Microservices & Platform Engineering

- [Transactions Aren't Enough: The Need For End-To-End Thinking](https://blog.allegro.tech/2025/12/transactions-arent-enough.html): Why ACID transactions alone can't prevent data loss in distributed systems
- [Migrating a microservice to Spring WebFlux](https://blog.allegro.tech/2019/07/migrating-microservice-to-spring-webflux.html): Production migration from Spring MVC to WebFlux reactive architecture
- [Persisting application state](https://blog.allegro.tech/2020/06/persisting-application-state.html): Aggregate & repository patterns for state persistence in Spring/MongoDB

## Code Migration & Build Automation

- [Automating Code Migrations at Scale](https://blog.allegro.tech/2024/09/automating-code-migrations-at-scale.html): Using OpenRewrite & Dependabot to automate code migrations across 2000+ services
